1246: // ── Archetype position rules ────────────────────────────────
1247: const POSITION_GROUP = {
1248:   'Center':     'forward',
1249:   'Left Wing':  'forward',
1250:   'Right Wing': 'forward',
1251:   'Defenseman': 'defense',
1252:   'Goalie':     'goalie',
1253: };
1254: 
1255: const VALID_ARCHETYPES = {
1256:   forward: ['Sniper', 'Playmaker', 'Power Forward', 'Two-Way Forward'],
1257:   defense: ['Offensive Defenseman', 'Defensive Defenseman'],
1258:   goalie:  ['Butterfly Goalie', 'Athletic Goalie', 'Hybrid Goalie'],
1259: };
1260: 
1261: function getPositionGroup(position) {
1262:   return POSITION_GROUP[position] || '';
1263: }
1264: 
1265: function isArchetypeValidForPosition(archetype, position) {
1266:   const group = getPositionGroup(position);
1267:   if (!group) return false;
1268:   return (VALID_ARCHETYPES[group] || []).includes(archetype);
1269: }
1270: 
1271: function filterArchetypeCards() {
1272:   const group = getPositionGroup(Game.player.position);
1273:   document.querySelectorAll('#archetype-screen .bg-card').forEach((card) => {
1274:     const show = card.dataset.positionGroup === group;
1275:     card.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
1276:   });
1277: }

1279: function renderTrainingOptions() {
1280:   if (
1281:     !trainingOptions ||
1282:     typeof WorldEngine
1283:       ?.getTrainingTypes !==
1284:       'function'
1285:   ) {
1286:     return;
1287:   }
1288: 
1289:   const trainingCatalog =
1290:     WorldEngine.getTrainingTypes();
1291: 
1292:   const positionGroup =
1293:     getPositionGroup(
1294:       Game.player.position
1295:     );
1296: 
1297:   const trainingPool =
1298:     positionGroup === 'goalie'
1299:       ? trainingCatalog.goalie
1300:       : trainingCatalog.skater;
1301: 
1302:   /*
1303:    * WEEKLY TRAINING SELECTION
1304:    *
1305:    * Show a stable random subset of the full Training catalog.
1306:    * The same Training date always produces the same choices,
1307:    * even after reloading the save.
1308:    */
1309:   const activeTrainingEvent =
1310:     Array.isArray(
1311:       WorldEngine.state.schedule
1312:     )
1313:       ? WorldEngine.state.schedule.find(
1314:           event =>
1315:             String(
1316:               event?.id ||
1317:               event?.eventId ||
1318:               ''
1319:             ) ===
1320:             String(
1321:               activeTrainingEventId ||
1322:               ''
1323:             )
1324:         )
1325:       : null;
1326: 
1327:   const trainingDate =
1328:     activeTrainingEvent?.date ||
1329:     Game.player.currentDate ||
1330:     'training';
1331: 
1332:   const stableTrainingScore =
1333:     training => {
1334:       const seedText =
1335:         `${trainingDate}-${training.trainingKey}`;
1336: 
1337:       let hash = 0;
1338: 
1339:       for (
1340:         let index = 0;
1341:         index < seedText.length;
1342:         index += 1
1343:       ) {
1344:         hash =
1345:           (
1346:             (hash << 5) -
1347:             hash
1348:           ) +
1349:           seedText.charCodeAt(
1350:             index
1351:           );
1352: 
1353:         hash |= 0;
1354:       }
1355: 
1356:       return Math.abs(hash);
1357:     };
1358: 
1359:   const choiceCount =
1360:     Math.min(
1361:       trainingPool.length,
1362:       4 +
1363:         (
1364:           stableTrainingScore({
1365:             trainingKey:
1366:               'weekly-choice-count',
1367:           }) % 3
1368:         )
1369:     );
1370: 
1371:   const weeklyTrainingPool =
1372:     [...trainingPool]
1373:       .sort(
1374:         (firstTraining, secondTraining) =>
1375:           stableTrainingScore(
1376:             firstTraining
1377:           ) -
1378:           stableTrainingScore(
1379:             secondTraining
1380:           )
1381:       )
1382:       .slice(
1383:         0,
1384:         choiceCount
1385:       );
1386: 
1387:     if (
1388:       !Array.isArray(weeklyTrainingPool) ||
1389:       weeklyTrainingPool.length === 0
1390:     ) {
1391:     trainingOptions.innerHTML = `
1392:       <div class="training-empty">
1393:         No training options are available.
1394:       </div>
1395:     `;
1396: 
1397:     return;
1398:   }
1399: 
1400:   const formatAttributeLabel =
1401:     attributeKey => {
1402:       const labelMap = {
1403:         wristShotPower:
1404:           'Wrist Shot Power',
1405: 
1406:         wristShotAccuracy:
1407:           'Wrist Shot Accuracy',
1408: 
1409:         slapShotPower:
1410:           'Slap Shot Power',
1411: 
1412:         slapShotAccuracy:
1413:           'Slap Shot Accuracy',
1414: 
1415:         passing:
1416:           'Passing',

2813: /*
2814:  * ============================================================
2815:  * CAREER LOAD — SCHEDULE MIGRATION
2816:  * ============================================================
2817:  *
2818:  * Older saves may contain only the original game schedule.
2819:  * Newer builds also require Practice, Recovery, Training,
2820:  * meetings, etc.
2821:  *
2822:  * Rebuild the canonical season schedule, then preserve all
2823:  * existing completion/results data from the saved world.
2824:  */
2825: function ensureCareerScheduleEventsOnLoad() {
2826:   const existingSchedule =
2827:     Array.isArray(
2828:       WorldEngine.state.schedule
2829:     )
2830:       ? WorldEngine.state.schedule
2831:       : [];
2832: 
2833:   const hasCareerEvents =
2834:     existingSchedule.some(event =>
2835:       [
2836:         'practice',
2837:         'recovery',
2838:         'training',
2839:       ].includes(
2840:         String(
2841:           event?.type || ''
2842:         ).toLowerCase()
2843:       )
2844:     );
2845: 
2846:   /*
2847:    * Current saves that already contain the expanded schedule
2848:    * need no migration.
2849:    */
2850:   if (hasCareerEvents) {
2851:     return false;
2852:   }
2853: 
2854:   const rebuiltSchedule =
2855:     WorldEngine
2856:       .createHighSchoolCareerSchedule(
2857:         WorldEngine.state.teams
2858:       );
2859: 
2860:   if (
2861:     !Array.isArray(rebuiltSchedule) ||
2862:     rebuiltSchedule.length === 0
2863:   ) {
2864:     console.error(
2865:       '[Career Load] Could not rebuild canonical schedule.'
2866:     );
2867: 
2868:     return false;
2869:   }
2870: 
2871:   /*
2872:    * Match an old event to its regenerated counterpart.
2873:    *
2874:    * Prefer permanent IDs. Fall back to date/type/team matchup
2875:    * for older game records whose identifiers may differ.
2876:    */
2877:   const findExistingEvent =
2878:     newEvent => {
2879:       const newIds = [
2880:         newEvent?.eventId,
2881:         newEvent?.gameId,
2882:         newEvent?.id,
2883:       ]
2884:         .filter(Boolean)
2885:         .map(String);
2886: 
2887:       const byId =
2888:         existingSchedule.find(
2889:           existingEvent => {
2890:             const existingIds = [
2891:               existingEvent?.eventId,
2892:               existingEvent?.gameId,
2893:               existingEvent?.id,
2894:             ]
2895:               .filter(Boolean)
2896:               .map(String);
2897: 
2898:             return newIds.some(id =>
2899:               existingIds.includes(id)
2900:             );
2901:           }
2902:         );
2903: 
2904:       if (byId) {
2905:         return byId;
2906:       }
2907: 
2908:       return (
2909:         existingSchedule.find(
2910:           existingEvent =>
2911:             String(
2912:               existingEvent?.date || ''
2913:             ) ===
2914:               String(
2915:                 newEvent?.date || ''
2916:               ) &&
2917:             String(
2918:               existingEvent?.type || ''
2919:             ) ===
2920:               String(
2921:                 newEvent?.type || ''
2922:               ) &&
2923:             String(
2924:               existingEvent?.homeTeamId ||
2925:               ''
2926:             ) ===
2927:               String(
2928:                 newEvent?.homeTeamId ||
2929:                 ''
2930:               ) &&
2931:             String(
2932:               existingEvent?.awayTeamId ||
2933:               ''
2934:             ) ===
2935:               String(
2936:                 newEvent?.awayTeamId ||
2937:                 ''
2938:               )
2939:         ) ||
2940:         null
2941:       );
2942:     };
2943: 
2944:   WorldEngine.state.schedule =
2945:     rebuiltSchedule.map(
2946:       newEvent => {
2947:         const existingEvent =
2948:           findExistingEvent(
2949:             newEvent
2950:           );
2951: 
2952:         if (!existingEvent) {
2953:           return newEvent;
2954:         }
2955: 
2956:         /*
2957:          * Keep the regenerated event definition, but preserve
2958:          * all saved progress/results from the old record.
2959:          */
2960:         return {
2961:           ...newEvent,
2962:           ...existingEvent,
2963: 
2964:           /*
2965:            * Preserve canonical identity fields from the new
2966:            * schedule when the old save did not contain them.
2967:            */
2968:           eventId:
2969:             existingEvent.eventId ||
2970:             newEvent.eventId,
2971: 
2972:           gameId:
2973:             existingEvent.gameId ||
2974:             newEvent.gameId,
2975: 
2976:           id:
2977:             existingEvent.id ||
2978:             newEvent.id,
2979:         };
2980:       }
2981:     );
2982: 
2983:   WorldEngine.save();
2984: 
2985:   console.log(
2986:     '[Career Load] Expanded schedule migrated successfully.'
2987:   );
2988: 
2989:   return true;
2990: }

5161: // ── Standings ────────────────────────────────────────────────
5162: // Shared sort used by both the hub preview card and the full standings screen.
5163: // Sort order: Points desc → Wins desc → Goal Differential desc.
5164: function getSortedStandings() {
5165:   return [...WorldEngine.state.teams].sort((a, b) => {
5166:     if (b.points !== a.points)           return b.points - a.points;
5167:     if (b.wins   !== a.wins)             return b.wins   - a.wins;
5168:     const gdA = a.goalsFor - a.goalsAgainst;
5169:     const gdB = b.goalsFor - b.goalsAgainst;
5170:     return gdB - gdA;
5171:   });
5172: }
5173:

5679:     (Number(player.points) || 0);

5682:     (Number(player.assists) || 0) * 100 +

5694:         player.defensiveRating ??
5695:         player.defense

5701:       defensiveRating * 0.15

6937: /* ============================================================
6938:    POSTGAME SUMMARY
6939:    Opens the permanently saved result for one completed game.
6940:    Used both immediately after simulation and from Schedule.

6943: function openPostgameSummary(gameId) {
6944:   const schedule =
6945:     Array.isArray(
6946:       WorldEngine.state.schedule
6947:     )
6948:       ? WorldEngine.state.schedule
6949:       : [];

6952:     String(gameId || '');

6957:         game?.gameId,
6958:         game?.id,
6959:         game?.eventId,
6960:         game?.postgameSummary?.gameId,

6962:         alias !== null &&
6963:         alias !== undefined &&
6964:         String(alias) === targetGameId
6965:       )
6966:     );

6969:     scheduledGame?.gameId ||
6970:     scheduledGame?.id ||

6975:       scheduledGame?.postgameSummary ||
6976:       null;

6978:     /*
6979:      * Older completed career games may have a valid frozen
6980:      * box score but no usable Development Engine result because
6981:      * they were completed before the participation/progression
6982:      * fixes.
6983:      *
6984:      * Repair only when the saved progression package is missing.
6985:      * The World Engine's permanent game-log guard prevents the
6986:      * same game from awarding XP twice.
6987:      */

6989:       Boolean(
6990:         summary
6991:           ?.development
6992:           ?.progressionResult
6993:           ?.created === true
6994:       );

7000:         .repairCompletedGameDevelopment ===
7001:           'function'

7009:           WorldEngine
7010:             .repairCompletedGameDevelopment(

7023:             repairResult

7029:           error

9370: function pickStableEvent(items, dateKey, salt = '') {
9371:   const seedText = `${dateKey}-${salt}`;
9372: 
9373:   let hash = 0;
9374: 
9375:   for (let i = 0; i < seedText.length; i++) {
9376:     hash =
9377:       ((hash << 5) - hash) +
9378:       seedText.charCodeAt(i);
9379: 
9380:     hash |= 0;
9381:   }
9382: 
9383:   const index =
9384:     Math.abs(hash) % items.length;
9385: 
9386:   return items[index];
9387: }

15910: function getTryoutLetterGrade(score) {
15911:   if (score >= 97) return 'A+';
15912:   if (score >= 93) return 'A';
15913:   if (score >= 90) return 'A−';
15914:   if (score >= 87) return 'B+';
15915:   if (score >= 83) return 'B';
15916:   if (score >= 80) return 'B−';
15917:   if (score >= 77) return 'C+';
15918:   if (score >= 73) return 'C';
15919:   if (score >= 70) return 'C−';
15920:   if (score >= 67) return 'D+';
15921:   if (score >= 63) return 'D';
15922:   if (score >= 60) return 'D−';
15923:   return 'F';
15924: }
15925: 
15926: function getOverallTryoutFeedback(score) {
15927:   if (score >= 93) {
15928:     return 'An exceptional tryout. You consistently stood out in all three evaluations.';
15929:   }
15930: 
15931:   if (score >= 85) {
15932:     return 'A strong overall performance. You showed that you can contribute at this level.';
15933:   }
15934: 
15935:   if (score >= 75) {
15936:     return 'A solid tryout with several encouraging moments. Continued development will be important.';
15937:   }
15938: 
15939:   if (score >= 65) {
15940:     return 'You competed hard, but several parts of your game still need refinement.';
15941:   }
15942: 
15943:   return 'The effort was there, but the coaching staff believes you need significant development.';
15944: }

1824:       new Date(
1825:         '2026-09-08T12:00:00'
1826:       );

1830:         '2027-03-31T12:00:00'
1831:       );

1917:           dateKey,
1918:

1947:           EVENT_TYPES.TRAINING,

1959:   function createHighSchoolCareerSchedule(
1960:     teams = []
1961:   ) {
1962:     const gameEvents =
1963:       createHighSchoolSchedule(
1964:         teams
1965:       ).map(game => ({
1966:         ...game,
1967: 
1968:         /*
1969:          * League games previously relied on their team fields
1970:          * to identify them. Give every canonical schedule entry
1971:          * an explicit event type.
1972:          */
1973:         type:
1974:           EVENT_TYPES.GAME,
1975: 
1976:         completed:
1977:           Boolean(game.played),
1978: 
1979:         source:
1980:           'league-schedule',
1981:       }));
1982: 
1983:       const lifeEvents =
1984:         createHighSchoolLifeEvents();
1985: 
1986:       /*
1987:        * A league game takes priority over Practice or Recovery.
1988:        * Remove conflicting life events here so the World Engine
1989:        * and Schedule UI always process the same visible event.
1990:        */
1991:       const gameDates =
1992:         new Set(
1993:           gameEvents.map(
1994:             game => game.date
1995:           )
1996:         );
1997: 
1998:       const filteredLifeEvents =
1999:         lifeEvents.filter(
2000:           event =>
2001:             !gameDates.has(
2002:               event.date
2003:             )
2004:         );
2005: 
2006:       return [
2007:         ...gameEvents,
2008:         ...filteredLifeEvents,
2009:       ].sort((firstEvent, secondEvent) => {
2010:       const dateComparison =
2011:         String(firstEvent.date)
2012:           .localeCompare(
--- lines 2021-2062 ---
2021:         firstEvent.id || ''
2022:       ).localeCompare(
2023:         String(secondEvent.id || '')
2024:       );
2025:     });
2026:   }
2027:   // ── EA NHL-style potential system ───────────────────────────
2028: 
2029:   function getPotentialRole(position, numericPotential) {
2030:     const pos = String(position || 'C').toUpperCase();
2031:     const potential = Number(numericPotential) || 75;
2032: 
2033:     const isGoalie = pos === 'G';
2034:     const isDefense =
2035:       pos === 'D' ||
2036:       pos === 'LD' ||
2037:       pos === 'RD';
2038: 
2039:     if (isGoalie) {
2040:       if (potential >= 96) return 'Franchise';
2041:       if (potential >= 90) return 'Elite';
2042:       if (potential >= 84) return 'Starter';
2043:       if (potential >= 79) return 'Fringe Starter';
2044:       if (potential >= 74) return 'Backup';
2045:       return 'AHL Starter';
2046:     }
2047:

5981:   function distributeTeamGoals(
5982:     teamGameResult,
5983:     gameRandom
5984:   ) {
5985:     if (
5986:       !teamGameResult ||

5999:           0,
6000:

6028:      * Build one selectable ticket for every recorded shot.
6029:      * This ensures:
6030:      *
6031:      * - players with more shots are more likely to score,
6032:      * - every goal belongs to an actual shooter,
6033:      * - no player can score more goals than they had shots.
6034:      */
6035:     const availableShotTickets = [];

6053:             playerId:
6054:               skater.playerId,
6055: 
6056:             shotIndex,
6057:           });
6058:         }
6059:       }
6060:     );
6061: 
6062:     if (
6063:       availableShotTickets.length <
6064:       teamGoals

6066:       return {
6067:         success: false,
6068: 
6069:         reason:
6070:           'not-enough-player-shots-for-goals',
6071: 
6072:         assignedGoals:
6073:           0,
6074: 
6075:         scorers: [],
6076:       };
6077:     }
6078:

6080: 
6081:     for (
6082:       let goalIndex = 0;
6083:       goalIndex < teamGoals;
6084:       goalIndex++

6087:         gameRandom.integer(
6088:           0,
6089:           availableShotTickets.length - 1
6090:         );
6091: 
6092:       const [
6093:         selectedTicket,
6094:       ] =
6095:         availableShotTickets.splice(
6096:           selectedTicketIndex,
6097:           1
6098:         );
6099:

6101:         teamGameResult.skaters.find(
6102:           skater =>
6103:             String(
6104:               skater.playerId
6105:             ) ===
6106:             String(
6107:               selectedTicket.playerId
6108:             )
6109:         );
6110: 
6111:       if (!scorerLine) {
6112:         return {
6113:           success: false,

6116:             'goal-scorer-line-not-found',
6117: 
6118:           assignedGoals:
6119:             scorers.length,
6120: 
6121:           scorers,
6122:         };
6123:       }
6124: 
6125:       scorerLine.goals =
6126:         (

6162:       });
6163:     }

6166:       teamGameResult.skaters.reduce(
6167:         (total, skater) =>

6169:           (
6170:             Number(
6171:               skater.goals
6172:             ) || 0
6173:           ),
6174:         0
6175:       );
6176: 
6177:     return {
6178:       success:
6179:         assignedGoals ===
6180:         teamGoals,
6181: 
6182:       reason:
6183:         assignedGoals ===
6184:           teamGoals
6185:           ? 'team-goals-distributed'

6187: 
6188:       assignedGoals,

6238:     function buildScoringPlays(
6239:       teamGameResult,
6240:       opposingGoalies,
6241:       gameRandom,
6242:       isHomeTeam = false
6243:     ) {
6244:     if (
6245:       !teamGameResult ||
6246:       !Array.isArray(teamGameResult.skaters)
6247:     ) {

6256:

6258:       teamGameResult.skaters.flatMap(
6259:         skater => {
6260:

6262:             Number(skater.goals) || 0;
6263:

6276:           createEmptyScoringPlay();

6279:          * Distribute goals across regulation.
6280:          * Version 1 uses a weighted period selection

6282:          * similar to real hockey scoring distributions.
6283:          */
6284:         const periodRoll =
6285:           gameRandom.range(
6286:             0,
6287:             100
6288:           );
6289: 
6290:         if (periodRoll < 31) {
6291:           play.period = 1;
6292:         } else if (
6293:           periodRoll < 67
6294:         ) {
6295:           play.period = 2;
6296:         } else {
6297:           play.period = 3;
6298:         }

6300:         /*
6301:          * Random time remaining in the selected period.
6302:          * Later this will become chronological.

6321:           ).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(
6322:             59 - seconds
6323:           ).padStart(2, '0')}`;

6329:             20 *
6330:             60 +
6331:           totalSeconds;
6332: 
6333:         play.goalNumber =
6334:           index + 1;

6336:         play.teamId =
6337:           teamGameResult.teamId;
6338: 
6339:         play.isHomeGoal =
6340:           Boolean(isHomeTeam);

6346:           scorer.name;

6367:          * The scorer cannot assist their own goal,

6369:          */
6370:         const assistPool =
6371:           teamGameResult.skaters.filter(

6426:               remainingAssistPool[

6452:               (
6453:                 Number(
6454:                   secondary.assists

6457:           }

6460:         scoringPlays.push(

6464:       }

6467:       /*
6468:        * Keep this team’s scoring plays chronological.

6470:        * after home and away plays are merged together.

6472:       scoringPlays.sort(

6489:     return {
6490:       success: true,
6491:       reason:
6492:         'scoring-plays-created',
6493:       scoringPlays,
6494:     };
6495:   }

6497:   function buildGameTimeline(
6498:     gameResult,

8131:   function validateGameResult(
8132:     gameResult
8133:   ) {
8134:     const homeGoals =
8135:       gameResult.home.skaters.reduce(
8136:         (total, skater) =>
8137:           total +
8138:           (Number(skater.goals) || 0),
8139:         0
8140:       );
8141: 
8142:     const awayGoals =
8143:       gameResult.away.skaters.reduce(
8144:         (total, skater) =>
8145:           total +
8146:           (Number(skater.goals) || 0),
8147:         0
8148:       );
8149: 
8150:     const homeShots =
8151:       gameResult.home.skaters.reduce(
8152:         (total, skater) =>
8153:           total +
8154:           (Number(skater.shots) || 0),
8155:         0
8156:       );
8157: 
8158:     const awayShots =
8159:       gameResult.away.skaters.reduce(
8160:         (total, skater) =>
8161:           total +
8162:           (Number(skater.shots) || 0),
8163:         0
8164:       );
8165: 
8166:     const timelineGoals =
8167:       Array.isArray(
8168:         gameResult.scoringPlays
8169:       )
8170:         ? gameResult.scoringPlays.length
8171:         : 0;
8172: 
8173:     const expectedGoals =
8174:       gameResult.home.score +
8175:       gameResult.away.score;
8176: 
8177:     return {
8178:       success:
8179:         homeGoals === gameResult.home.score &&
8180:         awayGoals === gameResult.away.score &&
8181:         homeShots === gameResult.home.shots &&
8182:         awayShots === gameResult.away.shots &&
8183:         timelineGoals === expectedGoals,
8184: 
8185:       checks: {
8186:         homeGoalsMatch:
8187:           homeGoals ===
8188:           gameResult.home.score,
8189: 
8190:         awayGoalsMatch:
8191:           awayGoals ===
8192:           gameResult.away.score,
8193: 
8194:         homeShotsMatch:
8195:           homeShots ===
8196:           gameResult.home.shots,
8197: 
8198:         awayShotsMatch:
8199:           awayShots ===
8200:           gameResult.away.shots,
8201: 
8202:         timelineMatches:
8203:           timelineGoals ===
8204:           expectedGoals,
8205:       },
8206: 
8207:       totals: {
8208:         homeGoals,
8209:         awayGoals,
8210:         homeShots,
8211:         awayShots,
8212:         timelineGoals,
8213:         expectedGoals,
8214:       },
8215:     };
8216:   }

18595:    */
18596:   function resolveLiveGameShootout(
18597:     simulation

18599:     if (

18922:         ...awayAttempt,
18923:         round:

18928:         3 - homeAttempts;
18929:

18931:         awayShootoutGoals >
18932:         homeShootoutGoals +

19158:    * ============================================================
19159:    *

19162:    *
19163:    * This is deliberately separate from event generation.
19164:    *
19165:    * A single minute may contain:

21803:   /*
21804:    * ============================================================
21805:    * LIVE GAME — GOALIE SAVE PROFILE
21806:    * ============================================================
21807:    *
21808:    * Builds an attribute-driven profile for the goalie currently
21809:    * facing a live shot.
21810:    *
21811:    * Overall is deliberately NOT used as a hidden save modifier.
21812:    * A goalie succeeds because the goalie attributes that make up
21813:    * his game are actually strong.
21814:    *
21815:    * Shot-location-specific ratings such as glove / blocker /
21816:    * five-hole will be layered in when shot types and locations
21817:    * are added.
21818:    */
21819:   function getLiveGameGoalieSaveProfile(
21820:     goalieLine
21821:   ) {
21822:     if (
21823:       !goalieLine ||
21824:       !goalieLine.playerId
21825:     ) {
21826:       return {
21827:         success: false,
21828:         reason:
21829:           'goalie-line-missing',
21830:       };
21831:     }
21832: 
21833:     const canonicalGoalie =
21834:       getPlayerById(
21835:         goalieLine.playerId
21836:       );
21837: 
21838:     if (!canonicalGoalie) {
21839:       return {
21840:         success: false,
21841:         reason:
21842:           'canonical-goalie-missing',
21843:       };
21844:     }
21845: 
21846:     const attributes =
21847:       canonicalGoalie
21848:         .attributes ||
21849:       {};
21850: 
21851:     const clampRating =
21852:       value =>
21853:         Math.max(
21854:           25,
21855:           Math.min(
21856:             99,
21857:             Number(value) || 50
21858:           )
21859:         );
21860: 
21861:     const reflexes =
21862:       clampRating(
21863:         attributes.reflexes
21864:       );
21865: 
21866:     const puckTracking =
21867:       clampRating(
21868:         attributes.puckTracking
21869:       );

21895: 
21896:     const reboundControl =
21897:       clampRating(
21898:         attributes.reboundControl
21899:       );
21900: 
21901:     /*
21902:      * ==========================================================
21903:      * CORE SAVE ABILITY
21904:      * ==========================================================
21905:      *
21906:      * Reflexes and tracking matter most on ordinary live shots.
21907:      * Positioning keeps the goalie structurally sound.
21908:      * Lateral movement matters when play moves across the ice.
21909:      * Anticipation and composure represent reading the attack.
21910:      * Consistency adds a smaller stabilizing component.
21911:      */
21912:     const saveAbility =
21913:       reflexes * 0.22 +
21914:       puckTracking * 0.20 +
21915:       positioning * 0.18 +
21916:       lateralMovement * 0.13 +
21917:       anticipation * 0.11 +
21918:       composure * 0.09 +
21919:       consistency * 0.07;
21920: 
21921:     /*
21922:      * Rebound prevention deserves its own rating because making
21923:      * the initial save and controlling the rebound are different
21924:      * goalie skills.
21925:      */
21926:     const reboundAbility =
21927:       reboundControl * 0.55 +
21928:       positioning * 0.15 +
21929:       puckTracking * 0.12 +
21930:       composure * 0.10 +
21931:       reflexes * 0.08;
21932: 
21933:     /*
21934:      * Scramble ability becomes especially useful following rebounds
21935:      * or chaotic net-front sequences.
21936:      */
21937:     const scrambleAbility =
21938:       reflexes * 0.28 +
21939:       lateralMovement * 0.22 +
21940:       puckTracking * 0.18 +
21941:       composure * 0.14 +
21942:       anticipation * 0.10 +
21943:       positioning * 0.08;
21944: 
21945:     return {
21946:       success: true,
21947: 
21948:       reason:
21949:         'goalie-save-profile-created',
21950: 
21951:       playerId:
21952:         goalieLine.playerId,
21953: 
21954:       saveAbility:
21955:         Math.max(
21956:           25,
21957:           Math.min(
21958:             99,
21959:             saveAbility
21960:           )
21961:         ),
21962: 
21963:       reboundAbility:
21964:         Math.max(
21965:           25,
21966:           Math.min(
21967:             99,
21968:             reboundAbility
21969:           )
21970:         ),
21971: 
21972:       scrambleAbility:
21973:         Math.max(
21974:           25,
21975:           Math.min(

22305:   }

22307:   /*
22308:    * ============================================================
22309:    * LIVE GAME — SHOT ATTEMPT RESOLUTION
22310:    * ============================================================
22311:    *
22312:    * Resolves one shot attempt into:
22313:    *
22314:    * blocked
22315:    * missed
22316:    * saved
22317:    * goal
22318:    *
22319:    * Uses real deployed players, canonical attributes, current
22320:    * zone pressure, and the defending goalie.
22321:    */
22322:   function resolveLiveGameShotAttempt(
22323:     simulation,
22324:     forcedShooterPlayerId = null,
22325:     forcedShotType = null
22326:   ) {
22327:     if (
22328:       !simulation ||
22329:       typeof simulation !== 'object'
22330:     ) {
22331:       return {
22332:         success: false,
22333:         reason:
22334:           'invalid-live-game',
22335:         event: null,
22336:       };
22337:     }
22338: 
22339:     const flow =
22340:       simulation.flow &&
22341:       typeof simulation.flow === 'object'
22342:         ? simulation.flow
22343:         : null;
22344: 
22345:     if (
22346:       !flow ||
22347:       flow.stopped === true
22348:     ) {
22349:       return {
22350:         success: false,
22351:         reason:
22352:           'live-game-not-in-flowing-play',
22353:         event: null,
22354:       };
22355:     }
22356: 
22357:     const attackingSide =
22358:       flow.possessionSide;
22359: 
22360:     if (
22361:       attackingSide !== 'home' &&
22362:       attackingSide !== 'away'
22363:     ) {
22364:       return {
22365:         success: false,
22366:         reason:
22367:           'shot-possession-side-missing',
22368:         event: null,
22369:       };
22370:     }
22371: 
22372:     const defendingSide =
22373:       attackingSide === 'home'
22374:         ? 'away'
22375:         : 'home';
